requirementCatalog.REQ-FLAG-01: A complaint matching one of the prototype's disclosed red-flag phrases (English or Arabic) must produce urgency level "immediate" with reason "complaint".
requirementCatalog.REQ-FLAG-02: A complaint with no red-flag phrase but containing the prototype's priority terms (fever, vomit, abdominal pain, generic "pain" / حمى / حراره / قيء / الم) must produce urgency level "priority".
requirementCatalog.REQ-FLAG-03: A complaint matching the prototype's minor-injury terms (ankle, sprain, minor / كاحل / التواء) must produce urgency level "standard".
requirementCatalog.REQ-FLAG-04: Complaint text not recognized by any rule must fall back to urgency level "unclassified" (reason "unknown"), which requires clinician assessment. This is the documented fallback, not a clinical classification.
requirementCatalog.REQ-NEG-01: Negation: per the source-code intent ("A negated phrase alone is not a positive symptom"), a negated red-flag phrasing must NOT produce urgency level "immediate". Covered negators in code: no / denies / without (English) and لا اعاني من / لا يوجد / بدون (Arabic).
requirementCatalog.REQ-VITAL-01: Abnormal vital values must produce urgency level "immediate" with reason "vitals". Disclosed thresholds: SpO2 < 92, systolic BP < 90, heart rate < 50 or > 130, respiratory rate < 8 or > 30, temperature >= 40.
requirementCatalog.REQ-VITAL-02: Boundary behavior: values exactly at a threshold must NOT trigger the flag (the comparisons are strict).
requirementCatalog.REQ-VAL-01: Intake validation must reject: missing name, IDs not matching 10 digits starting 1 or 2, age outside 0–120, empty complaint, non-numeric or out-of-range vital values, and inverted blood pressure (diastolic >= systolic), reporting named field errors.
requirementCatalog.REQ-NOTE-01: A structured SOAP note must be generated for every accepted intake, in both English and Arabic, preserving the patient's exact complaint and marking unverified values as unverified.
requirementCatalog.REQ-FHIR-01: FHIR export must generate a valid document Bundle containing Composition (first entry), Patient, Practitioner, Encounter, and an Observation for each available vital value.
